senses.gloss: bandhaka, nt., container, case (for holding knives): śastraṃ nāsti, tayā ˚kaṃ gṛhītam, śastraṃ dattam MSV 〔ii.79.8〕. Cf. Skt. kṣura-bhāṇḍa, Pali khura-bhaṇḍa, razor-case; perh. read bhāndakam in MSV?
Bandhanāntakara, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔i.140.10〕.
bandha-nikṣepa, bond-pledge, guarantee (to support an assertion): Av 〔i.47.10〕.
Bandhumā (presumably = ˚matī, cf. ˚ma = ˚mant, but app. a different city), n. of a capital city where it is prophesied that the Buddha Maitreya will be born: ˚māyāṃ rājadhānyāṃ Mv 〔i.51.7〕 (prose).
Bandhumatī (= Pali id.), n. of the capital city (rājadhānī) where Vipaśyin was born: Mv 〔ii.271.6〕; Divy 〔141.19〕; 〔227.23, 25〕; 〔282.23 ff.〕; Av 〔i.137.9〕; 〔349.5〕; 〔ii.109.5〕, etc.
Bandhumatīya, and ˚yaka, adj., belonging to Bandhumatī: ˚ye dāve Divy 〔283.23〕; ˚yake dāve Divy 〔282.24〕; Av 〔ii.109.5〕 (all prose).
Bandhumant (= Pali id., nom. ˚mā; cf. also Bandhuma), n. of a king of Bandhumatī, father of Vipaśyin: Divy 〔282.25〕; 〔283.21 ff.〕; Av 〔i.349.7〕 etc.
